## Summary

Describe the public-core change and the AI-independent contract or deterministic behavior it affects.

## Validation

List the checks, fixtures, or manual review used.

## Public disclosure checklist

- [ ] This change is independently useful without `guitar-practice-platform`.
- [ ] It contains no AI-related code, prompts, documentation, examples, fixtures, schemas, issues, or roadmap work.
- [ ] It introduces no model, provider, agent, retrieval, embedding, evaluation, guardrail, or AI-specific extension point.
- [ ] It contains no customer, personal-practice, recording, telemetry, or production data.
- [ ] It contains no secrets, credentials, private endpoints, or production configuration.
- [ ] It does not disclose proprietary ranking, adaptation, anti-abuse, or commercial logic.
- [ ] Content and examples are synthetic, owned, public domain, or licensed for redistribution.
- [ ] The public repository does not import or depend on private source code.
- [ ] Cross-repository behavior is expressed through an AI-independent, versioned contract.
- [ ] Product strategy, pricing, commercial roadmap, premium content, and all AI work remain private.

When any item cannot be checked, move the work to the private repository or extract a smaller AI-independent public mechanism.
